camera_tests: Missing interface, no exposed camera, unsupported count/layout, property failure, invalid intrinsics, baseline and calibration reject before acquisition. Valid synthetic metadata acquires/releases once. No-frame never creates depth.
change_scope: Frame binary_path_linux_arm manifest key; optional metadata registration cannot suppress dashboard creation; English room UI, notices and keyboard labels. Existing video/mask/codec binaries unchanged.
limits: Candidate 1 UI flicker, source refusal and concurrent compositor crash were observed. Cause of that crash was not isolated.

Candidate 2 was confirmed installed but exited before dashboard creation because its manifest was rejected. Candidate 3 fixes that startup path; its dashboard, UI stability, image completion and source admission still require a wearer test.
No claim of working live scan, automatic detection or game/Venture room adapters.
renderer_tests: 100 changing updates while one image is pending retain immutable bytes and create one submission. Completion permits the current image. Unchanged images do not resubmit. Missing completion expires. Stale controls cannot start a hidden camera action.
startup_tests: Skipped or rejected manifests, optional application API absence and failed identification all preserve dashboard creation. Valid metadata is associated normally.
validation_basis: Inherit exact unchanged transport binaries and their proven source closure; run affected room/native/camera/pipe, installer, package, PC-only, logging, bootstrap and sanitizer checks. No new native transport/GPU or headset validation claimed.
